body:
The navigation customization menu and card section menu now render the same
OrderVisibilityList component: six-dot grips, eye controls, row styling, pointer
previews, scrolling, cancellation, keyboard ordering and retained focus. Feature
wrappers preserve their existing storage and visibility rules. Shared popovers
also keep visibility targets stationary during held presses while a modal resizes.

The independent 612-test gate passes. The integrated committed source has 615
passing tests across the complete check set and an unchanged CLI/daemon retry;
Chromium/WebKit navigation, card layout and menus pass, plus 40 Chromium responsive
checks. Two CLI socket mocks initially timed out; no bounds or source were changed.

The rebuilt manual application is restarted and verified at the existing HTTPS
address. All 35 prior resource versions, two pins, both profiles' settings,
identity/epoch and certificate are preserved; all 46 served assets match. Live
320/390px checks confirm grip/eye controls, keyboard order/focus, visibility and
reset. Pending unrelated work is preserved. Physical-device and full release
acceptance remain open.

Evidence: progress/2026-10-04-navigation-section-selector.md.

metadata.summary: Shared navigation and card section controls verified
